source_frontmatter.name: astrophotography-processing
source_frontmatter.description: Router for astrophotography processing, troubleshooting, and safe workflow guidance across deep-sky, narrowband, planetary/lunar/solar, Milky Way landscape, comet, and mosaic data.
source_frontmatter.when_to_use: Use when the request involves astrophotography processing, FITS/XISF/RAW night-sky data, stacking, calibration frames (lights/darks/flats/bias/dark-flats), narrowband/OSC/LRGB workflows, Milky Way processing, comet processing, lunar/planetary/solar stacking, mosaics, PixInsight/Siril/APP/DSS, StarNet or StarXTerminator-style star workflows, or Python-based astro image audits/automation. Do not use for ordinary daytime portrait/product/photo editing unless the user is explicitly processing astronomy/night-sky data.
